_help: Config of shell-reaper.py, optional. Copy it to shell-reaper.json in the kit home (beside logs/) and replace these example values with your own. Set your own long jobs under exempt in shell-reaper.json first (or run the tool with --dry and read what it would kill) before installing the task: the task ends the whole process tree of any agent tool shell past 45 minutes with no wait token, 150 with a wait token, 390 with a gate token. exempt: tokens added to the kit's own (gradle, gradlew, java, lockrun, gate-detach), such as your queue runner or render server; a Bash tool shell whose command names one as a whole word, in any case, is never killed, only watched in the log past 390 minutes. repo_roots: the folders class C reports orphan trees under (report only, never a kill), each matched with either slash and in any case, as a whole folder (D:/work does not match D:/workshop); with none, class C reports nothing. Keys that start with an underscore are notes. Any other key, or a value that is not a list of non-empty strings, makes a run log one CONFIG-ERROR line, read and kill nothing, and exit 1.
